lead.t:
Immune thrombocytopenia in HIV
responds to steroids or immunoglobulins, together with ART.
Renal disease
HIV-associated nephropathy is an important cause of renal failure
and presents with nephrotic syndrome.

src.t: Devendra K. Gupta, Krishna M. Goel - Hutchison’s Paediatrics. chdhe-Jaypee Brothers (2012)

snip.t:
Immune thrombocytopenia in HIV
responds to steroids or immunoglobulins, together with ART.
Renal disease
HIV-associated nephropathy is an important cause of renal failure
and presents with nephrotic syndrome.

Occasionally, thrombocytopenia may be secondary
to maternal immune thrombocytopenia like idiopathic
thrombocytopenic purpura.
Alloimmune thrombocytopenia is not common but is
important because it may cause intracranial haemorrhage in
the foetus.
snip.s: Devendra K. Gupta, Krishna M. Goel - Hutchison’s Paediatrics. chdhe-Jaypee Broth
